what_it_is: Canonical maintainer release lane that resolves one sticky semver session, binds it to a specific commit, publishes signed release assets plus managed runtime bundles, validates dogfood plus consumer rehearsal flow, and owns the reusable GTM-and-release readiness overlay for proof-backed launch assets.
why_tracked: Makes Odylith's publication path a first-class governed subsystem instead of an undocumented maintainer ritual spread across ad hoc commands.
